تقتطعين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَطِعِينَ (taqtaṭiʕīna) /taq.ta.tˤi.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# تُقْتَطَعِينَ (tuqtaṭaʕīna) /tuq.ta.tˤa.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
